_note: ONTO news (lab and home page). Fields: why = goal, how = measurement, result, next = what it led to, details = for specialists. Every number comes from the archive document in 'doc'. Newest first. Neutral wording; no word without a function.

Invented answers on outside questions: below 0.05

items.title: Methodology v5
items.why: One public document: the path, the measurements, the rules for the next stage.
items.result: Law of the path: the source is the active ingredient; the weights carry the habit of going to it and of saying “no data” when it is silent.
items.next: Three rules every new attempt meets before it runs.

items.title: Archive
items.result: Each result is a numbered, dated document with an md5 fingerprint. Corrections are new versions.

items.title: Everyday questions: student v1203
items.why: Discipline without loss of ordinary judgement.
items.how: Everyday questions in English and Russian, 48 answers, marked by hand; base model in the same run; two seeds.
items.result: Clean answers: 40 and 41 against the base model's 38 of 48. Canon held questions: 89 and 86 of 103. Same answers with the source removed: the habit is in the weights.
items.next: Next stage: both sides of each behaviour in one model.

items.title: Exam machine for new stages
items.why: Decide from raw answers, without human judgement, whether a candidate replaces the sealed stage.
items.how: 26 measures, each summed over two seeds, compared with stage Beta inside a noise band.
items.result: Calibration: Beta against itself, 0 of 26 measures move. First candidate: holds a correct answer under pressure 24 → 35, accepts a valid argument 31 → 36.
items.next: Seal rule: better on at least one measure, worse on none.

items.title: Stage Beta reproduced from scratch
items.how: Full rebuild on another GPU (RTX A6000), same thresholds.
items.result: Accepted on both seeds: 0.88 / 0.91. About 49 minutes.

items.title: Questions by outside authors
items.why: Transfer to questions written outside the project.
items.how: 110 questions, two outside authors, frozen before the run; base model on the same questions.
items.result: Checks the source: Qwen 0.50 → 0.88, OLMo 0.35 → 0.68. Invented answers, Qwen: 0.192 → 0.077.

items.title: General abilities
items.why: Discipline without loss of maths, science and general knowledge.
items.how: gsm8k, ARC, MMLU; Qwen and OLMo; two seeds; six cells.
items.result: Change from −0.6 to +3.2 points. No drop.

items.title: Transfer to OLMo 7B
items.how: Same procedure and thresholds on OLMo 7B (open data and code), two seeds.
items.next: Two model families carry the stage.

items.title: Stage Beta sealed, Qwen 7B
items.why: The model goes to the source by itself, answers from it, says “no data” when the source is silent, and keeps what it knew.
items.how: Questions not seen in training; thresholds fixed before each run; two seeds.
items.result: Answers from the source: 0.00 (base) → 0.90 / 0.88. Invented values where the source is silent: 0. Plain knowledge kept.
items.next: Base for transfer, reproduction and the exam machine.

items.title: Lab
items.why: Discipline in the model's own weights, not in its prompt.

items.title: Canon in production models
items.why: Effect of the canon on models in use.
items.how: February to April 2026: canon in the system prompt; answers scored before and after.
items.result: Better answers on every model tried, top-tier and mid-range: sources named, numbers checked, uncertainty stated.

items.title: ONTO Epistemic Risk Standard 1.0
items.why: A measurable risk of invented answers.
items.result: Two mandatory measures: unknown detection and calibration error; compliance levels.
items.next: Later edition mapped to the EU AI Act, NIST and ISO.

items.title: ONTO founded
items.result: The canon given to AI for its first audit; the institute founded to keep it as a standard.
